data.label: Transformers & Large Language Models
data.description: Multi-Head Self-Attention mechanisms, encoder-decoder architectures (GPT/BERT), tokenization (BPE), Hugging Face libraries, and LoRA fine-tuning.
data.codeSnippet:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3-8B")
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3-8B", device_map="auto")
inputs = tokenizer("Theory of Computation:", return_tensors="pt").to("cuda")
outputs = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=50)

data.label: LLM Inference Engineering & Runtimes
data.description: Master the Roofline model, PagedAttention, KV-cache quantization, continuous batching (Orca), speculative decoding, and vLLM serving.
data.codeSnippet:
# vLLM High-Throughput Offline / Online Engine
from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
llm = LLM(model="meta-llama/Llama-3-8B-Instruct", enable_chunked_prefill=True)
sampling_params = SamplingParams(temperature=0.7, top_p=0.9, max_tokens=100)
outputs = llm.generate(["Explain the Roofline Model:", "What is PagedAttention?"], sampling_params)
